name: English
title: Aether Lemric — issue and project management. Coming soon.
description: Aether Lemric: issues, projects, configurable workflows and time tracking. In development, with self-hosted and SaaS editions planned.
heroDescription: Aether Lemric will bring projects, issues and workflows into one system. We are building it for teams that need to know what needs doing, who owns each task and what is blocking the next step.
stageNote: In development. Discover the planned features and product direction.
featuresTitle: Organised issues. Clear rules for your team.
issuesDescription: Issues with priorities, assignees and a change history. Lists, backlogs and boards will help teams plan their work and track its progress.
workflowDescription: States, transitions and conditions tailored to each project. Teams will see what is needed to close an issue and why a transition is blocked.
timeTitle: Time linked to the work done.
timeDescription: Manual entries, a timer and period approvals. A correction history will preserve the context of time records and accountability for every change.
previewDescription: An interface concept with sample data. It illustrates the planned way of working, rather than a finished application.
flowDescription: A transition changes an issue's state. Conditions determine when that transition can take place.
flowRuleText: Closing the issue requires approval. Without it, the issue remains in progress.
hostingTitle: The same product. Two deployment models.
hostingDescription: We are planning Aether as a self-hosted installation and as a service. Your team will choose where it runs.
selfDescription: A self-hosted installation for organisations that want to manage their own system and data. Also designed to work without a connection to the vendor's service.
cloudDescription: A SaaS edition for teams that want to use Aether without maintaining their own server. Lemric will manage the infrastructure.
launchDescription: We are starting with the foundations: issue tracking, the workflow engine and time records. The first release is planned for self-hosted installation and as a SaaS service.
launchTiming: We will announce the launch date when work on the first release is complete.
componentsDescription: Divide a project into areas and assign issues to them. Components will help teams find work related to a specific part of the product.
releasesDescription: Issues linked to planned releases. A version overview will show which tasks are ready and which still need work.
developmentDescription: Branches, commits and code reviews in the context of an issue. The planned view will connect each task with the code changes that address it.
dashboardDescription: Issue statuses, priorities and project progress in one view. A starting point for the team's daily review of its work.
boardsDescription: A backlog, iteration planning and tasks moving across a board. Agile and Kanban views will support both sprints and continuous delivery of work.
ganttDescription: Tasks on a timeline, dates and dependencies between work items. The Gantt view will help teams build a schedule and see the order of delivery.
